etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from Latin compōnēns, compōnēntis, present participle of compōnō (“assemble, put together”).

definitions.definition: A smaller, self-contained part of a larger entity. Often refers to a manufactured object that is part of a larger device.

quote.citation: 2013 September-October, Katie L. Burke, “In the News”, in American Scientist:
quote.text: Oxygen levels on Earth skyrocketed 2.4 billion years ago, when cyanobacteria evolved photosynthesis: […] . The evolutionary precursor of photosynthesis is still under debate, and a new study sheds light. The critical component of the photosynthetic system is the “water-oxidizing complex”, made up of manganese atoms and a calcium atom.

quote.citation: 2020 April 17, Yi Yan, “Chinese People Are Victims of the Chinese Communist Party's Lies”, in Minghui‎[1]:
quote.text: Lying is a key component of communism.

definitions.definition: (graph theory) A connected subgraph that is not part of any larger connected subgraph.
Made up of smaller complete units in combination.
